label: seed_ledger
purpose: Consumed and reserved raw replica-seed blocks and event-index partitions of the staged runs; run_contract.check_seed_disjointness refuses a run whose block or partition overlaps another run's entry. Kernel-layer substreams are keyed on the master seed, so distinct masters are disjoint by construction; the raw blocks are the legacy event-layer seeds. Historic entries are transcribed from the round records and cards.
